description:
Send a one-way text to the human's phone (a push notification, no
    ring). Use it for updates that need no answer, or as the fallback when a
    call comes back "missed" or "declined". delivered:false means it was saved
    to their history but no notification showed; `notice` says why. Their
    replies arrive through wait_for_reply. Missing `to` returns setup_required
    with the download links. Pass a previous session_token to stay in the
    same thread.

body.description: The message, up to 2000 characters. Markdown links render as links.
body.title: Body

from_label.description: Who is calling, shown on their phone and spoken: e.g. "Claude on my laptop".
from_label.title: From Label

session_token.description: A session_token from an earlier result, to stay in that thread. Omit on first contact.
session_token.title: Session Token

to.description: The human's 10-digit Call Me number, from My Number in the app (not a regular phone number). Local clients read it from ~/.aiphone/config.json user_number. In a host without file access, reuse a number given earlier in this chat, but do not claim it is saved across chats. Omit it only to get setup_required with the download links.
to.title: To

name: text

delivered.description: True when a notification was shown on the phone.
delivered.title: Delivered

from.description: Your own agent number. Never call or text it.
from.title: From

note.description: Extra information, e.g. from the demo line.
note.title: Note

notice.description: Why the text was saved but not shown, when delivered is false.
notice.title: Notice

ok.description: True when the message was stored.
ok.title: Ok

session_token.description: Reuse in later calls and texts to stay in one thread.
session_token.title: Session Token

title: Text the human
